issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes semantics when `from` is a directory or bare name
issues.detail: The original `resolve(s, from)` and the new `resolve(from, '..', s)` are not equivalent in all cases. When `from` is already a directory path, or when `s` is absolute, the '..' trick produces a different path. The fix is correct for the typical file-URL case but should be a one-line helper named after what it does, with a comment explaining why path.dirname of `from` is the right base. Cryptic argument tricks age badly.

issues.description: readFileSync on every external frame in the stack with no cache
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called per frame during stack parsing and reads the file from disk synchronously each time. A failing test with ten frames from the same transpiled module reads and re-parses that file ten times. Memoize by file path. This is the kind of thing the maintainer six months from now finds while profiling a slow reporter.

issues.description: Silent swallow of readFileSync/parse failures via existsSync race
issues.detail: existsSync followed by readFileSync is a TOCTOU pattern, and any throw from readFileSync or convertSourceMap.fromSource bubbles up and kills stack parsing for the whole error. Wrap the read+extract in a try/catch that returns undefined and logs at debug. An error reporter that throws while formatting an error is the worst possible failure mode.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as a fallback source map string is a code smell
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the literal string '{}' when the referenced map file is missing, relying on convert-source-map to tolerate it. Return undefined or throw a typed sentinel the caller handles explicitly. Magic empty-object strings are the kind of thing that works until the upstream library tightens validation.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile belongs in packages/utils, not test-run.ts
issues.detail: test-run.ts is the reporter glue. A generic 'read a file and pull its inline or referenced source map' helper is utility code that other call sites will want. Put it next to DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts where the rest of the source-map machinery lives. One patch, one place.

issues.description: No unit test for the resolve() fix in isolation
issues.detail: The snapshot update in stacktraces.test.ts proves the end-to-end behavior changed, but the one-line change in DecodedMap is the actual bug fix and deserves a direct test against DecodedMap with a known sources array and `from` URL. Snapshot deltas drift; a targeted assertion locks the invariant.

review.summary: The core one-line fix in DecodedMap is plausibly correct but uses a cryptic `resolve(from, '..', s)` idiom that should be a named helper with a comment, and lacks a direct unit test. The new external-module source-map path in test-run.ts works but reads files synchronously per stack frame with no cache, swallows nothing on read failures, and lives in the wrong package. Conditional NEEDS-WORK: split the source-map helper into packages/utils, add caching and try/catch around the disk reads, and add a focused test for the resolve change. Then it lands.
